_about: Risk tiering rubric for AI in hiring. Scores seven dimensions 0-3, applies a floor for systems that evaluate candidates, and checks prohibitions and red lines. Version-controlled: change the rubric here, never in the script.

video_interview_affect_analysis.title: Emotion or affect recognition as the basis of candidate evaluation
video_interview_affect_analysis.basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f) prohibits emotion recognition in the workplace (in force since 2 Feb 2025). Adopted organisation-wide as policy POL-AI-07 for all jurisdictions: the scientific basis for inferring emotion or personality from faces and voices is weak and the harm to candidates is serious.

RL-01.title: Emotion, affect or personality inferred from face, voice or behaviour
RL-01.basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f); policy POL-AI-07.
RL-01.remedy: Remove the module entirely (switching it off in configuration is not enough if scores are still computed or stored).

RL-02.title: Automated rejection in practice: rejections that rest on judgment are not reviewed by a person
RL-02.trigger: automation_level in [auto_archive, auto_reject, fully_automated]; OR auto_reject_hard_requirements without a person reviewing every judgment-based rejection; OR any other level where no person reviews every rejection
RL-02.basis: Policy POL-AI-03 (no consequential decision about a person without meaningful human review); India AI Governance Guidelines 'People First' sutra; GDPR Art. 22 and EU AI Act Art. 26(2) where EU candidates are in scope.
RL-02.remedy: A trained recruiter reviews every rejection that rests on a judgment of ability. Automated rejection is allowed only for documented, verifiable hard requirements, with notice, appeal and audit.

RL-04.title: Vendor refuses independent audit access
RL-04.basis: Policy POL-AI-05 (no high-risk system the organisation cannot verify).
RL-04.remedy: Contractual audit rights, or choose another vendor.

RL-06.title: Biometric categorisation inferring protected characteristics
RL-06.basis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(g); policy POL-AI-07.

T4.approver: AI Approval Committee + Board Risk Committee
